attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 27, `yggX` to `tkt`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 7% of calls. The model names 85 to 99.6% of them, fewest at column 7, `hemW`, 85%.

**A fork follows at `cmtB` and `cmtA`**, columns 28 and 29, carried by 89%, with a second family in 20 and 32%. Then columns 40 to 44, `srsR` to `scpA`, are variable, carried by 80 to 88%, in a region of plasticity in 60 to 65% of calls, [[methylmalonyl-coa mutase]]. The spine at columns 57 to 59, `gcvT` to `gcvP`, is [[glycine cleavage]].

**The model names about as many genes on the spine columns as on the fork and variable ones**, 94 against 93%, and hesitates less there, 0.26 against 0.34 bits.

**The window ends on fork and variable columns.** Columns 68 to 79, `xerD` to `ghxQ`, are carried by 40 to 90%, in a region of plasticity in 4 to 83% of calls.

**Across the window it names 94% of genes**, 0.28 bits on average, perplexity 1.4 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.69 against 0.18 bits, and names fewer genes, 85% against 96%.

label: yggX
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the yggX window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yggX, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 771 to 850 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yggX once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.28 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,114 calls, named 97%, 0.16 bits; shell 7,713 calls, named 80%, 0.74 bits; cloud 213 calls, named 3%, 5.05 bits. Outside an RGP 34,601 calls, named 96%, 0.18 bits; inside an RGP 8,439 calls, named 85%, 0.69 bits. Columns: 59 spine, 4 fork, 17 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.69 against 0.18 bits) and names fewer genes (85% against 96%); 8,439 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 21 (yqgD, a spine column) 0.83 bits, RGP 4%; column 7 (hemW, a spine column) 0.76 bits, RGP 6%; column 29 (cmtA, a fork column) 0.66 bits, RGP 7%. The 14 columns (columns 40-46 and 73-79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 93%, 0.36 bits on average; the other 66 columns: named 94%, 0.27 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 59 spine columns: named 94%, 0.26 bits on average; the 21 fork and variable columns: named 93%, 0.34 bits. The model names about as many genes on the spine columns as on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 21, is a spine column: the model can hesitate most inside a spine.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 45 (spine), RGP 64%; the least: columns 61-67 (spine), RGP 3-6%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-27 (28 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-7%. Genes: yggX "oxidative damage protection protein", mutY, trmB, yggL "YggL family protein", yggN "DUF2884 domain-containing protein", ansB, yggM "DUF1202 family protein", hemW, rdgB, yggU "DUF167 family protein YggU", yggT "osmotic shock tolerance protein YggT", yggS "pyridoxal phosphate homeostasis pro…", yggR "PilT/PilU family type 4a pilus ATPa…", ruvX, yqgE "YqgE/AlgH family protein", gshB, rsmE, endA, yggI "SprT family zinc-dependent metallop…", galP, metK, yqgD "protein YqgD", yqgG "protein YqgG", yqgB "acid stress response protein YqgB", speA "biosynthetic arginine decarboxylase", speB, loiP, tkt. named 85-99.6% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 7 (hemW), named 85%; most hesitant at column 21 (yqgD), 0.83 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 28-29 (2 columns) fork: share 89%, all P, RGP 6-7%. named 88-89% (mean 88%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 29, named 88%, 0.66 bits.
[S2.c28]    28: cmtB P 89%; also "IS1 family transposase" S 20%
[S2.c29]    29: cmtA P 89% "PTS mannitol transporter subunit II…"; also "prohibitin family protein" S 32%
[S3] 3. columns 30-39 (10 columns) spine: share 90-95%, all P, RGP 6-32%. Genes: yggP "zinc-binding dehydrogenase", glpX, fumE, yggC "nucleoside/nucleotide kinase family…", epd, pgk, fbaA, mscS, argO, yggE "oxidative stress defense protein". named 90-97% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 30 (yggP), named 90%, 0.46 bits.
[S4] 4. columns 40-44 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: share 80-88%, all S, RGP 60-65%. named 94-96% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 43, named 94%; most hesitant at column 41, 0.35 bits.
[S4.c40]    40 fork: srsR S 88%; also "PPC domain-containing DNA-binding prote…" S 28%
[S4.c41]    41 variable: scpC S 84% "propionyl-CoA:succinate CoA transfe…"
[S4.c42]    42 variable: scpB S 83%
[S4.c43]    43 variable: meaB S 80%
[S4.c44]    44 variable: scpA S 80%
[S5] 5. column 45 spine: share 95%, all P, RGP 64%. Genes: argP. named 94%; 0.25 bits.
[S6] 6. column 46 variable: share 72%, all S, RGP 58%. named 93%; 0.43 bits.
[S6.c46]    46: "LysR substrate-binding domain-containin…" S 72%
[S7] 7. columns 47-59 (13 columns) spine: share 94-96%, all P, RGP 7-32%. Genes: rpiA, serA, ibsC, fau, zapA, ygfB "UPF0149 family protein YgfB", pepP, ubiH, ubiI "FAD-dependent 2-octaprenylphenol hy…", "protein YqfI", gcvT "glycine cleavage system aminomethyl…", gcvH, gcvP. named 72-95% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 55 (ubiI), named 72%; most hesitant at column 59 (gcvP), 0.37 bits.
[S8] 8. column 60 variable: share 53%, all S, RGP 6%. named 91%; 0.38 bits.
[S8.c60]    60: ygfF S 53% "SDR family oxidoreductase"
[S9] 9. columns 61-67 (7 columns) spine: share 91-94%, all P, RGP 3-6%. [S10] 10. columns 68-79 (12 columns) fork and variable columns: share 40-90%, 8 P, 4 S, RGP 4-83%. named 89-97% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 79, named 89%; most hesitant at column 77, 0.57 bits.

[S10.c79]    79 fork: ghxQ P 40%; also guaD S 17%
